title: ChangesRow
description: One row of changes.parquet: a change-kind event from telemetry.events on the reference clock, with its scope, proximity to the target onset and changed-vs-peer contrast (03 §5.2). Written by Causync.

change_id.description: C + first 10 hex of SHA-256 of canonical_json({t_ns, entity, kind, source_system, detail_json, actor}) over the original event fields (t_ns before alignment, detail_json hashed as its string); duplicate ids are collapsed.

t_ns.description: Change time on the reference clock: event time + events offset.

entity.description: Changed entity from telemetry.events: a service, a component or a cluster-level object.

kind.description: Event kind (full event_kind vocabulary); Causync keeps the kinds in changes.kinds.

scope.description: service if entity is in case_manifest.services; component if it is a component in signal_cube.series; else cluster.

detail_json.description: Canonical JSON string copied unchanged from telemetry.events.detail_json.

latest_before_onset.description: True for every change of this entity at the latest t_ns <= target onset + tolerance_ns (equal timestamps are all latest).

delta_to_onset_ms.description: (t_ns - target onset) / 1e6 in ms; negative = before onset; null only if there is no onset at all.

proximity.description: exp(-max(0, O - t_ns) / tau_change) if t_ns <= O + tolerance_ns, else 0, where O is the target onset (a change recorded slightly after the onset, within tolerance, still counts); in [0, 1].

peer_contrast.description: Mean replica score of the changed set minus the median of unchanged peers, in raw robust z (max anomalies.score, detector robust_z); null if either set is empty or scope is cluster.
